title: tenageia vaillantii

It is valued for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tenageia vaillantii include lignans, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
